policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 22. Record five provenance-clean legacy knowledge Persons as verify-only science_retained dispositions where the representative historical identity is grounded in mathematics, physics, astronomy, scientific cartography/geography, or formal/empirical inquiry. No Production representative_domain write is requested; all five remain knowledge until the final atomic knowledge-to-science cutover.

review_scope.selection_rule: Choose five genuinely unreviewed live knowledge Persons with validator-compatible reviewed assignment provenance and strong science-side representative identity. Prefer direct mathematical, physical, astronomical, or scientific-cartographic contributions; defer unresolved philosophy/religion/governance and legacy Human Authoring provenance cases.

science_retained.basis: Einstein's representative historical identity is theoretical physics. His work on the photoelectric effect, Brownian motion, special relativity, general relativity, statistical mechanics, and quantum theory is central to modern physics. Under v2, physics and empirical/formal natural inquiry belong to science; the stored value remains knowledge until final cutover.

Madhava is represented above all as a mathematician-astronomer of the Kerala school. The reviewed history-of-mathematics evidence emphasizes his advances in infinite series, trigonometric expansions, and work foundational to mathematical analysis. Under v2, mathematics and astronomy belong to science.

Mercator's representative identity is scientific cartography and geography rather than expeditionary exploration. Library of Congress material describes him as a geographer and cartographer who advanced cartography as a science through globes, maps, projections, atlases, mathematical instruments, and a projection that solved a geometric representation problem. Under v2, this formal and empirical geographic inquiry belongs to science.

Kim Jeong-ho is represented as a geographer devoted to producing and systematizing geographic knowledge through major maps and gazetteers. The Academy of Korean Studies describes his effort to produce a scientifically constructed nationwide map using consistent scale and to organize national geographic information systematically; the National Museum of Korea classifies Daedongyeojido within traditional science/geography. Under v2, this empirical and systematic geographic inquiry belongs to science rather than exploration.

Leibniz was also a major philosopher, jurist, historian, and diplomat, but his representative intellectual identity includes independent development and publication of differential and integral calculus, foundational mathematical notation, formal logic, and major work in physics. Under v2, these foundational mathematical and formal-scientific contributions support science as the representative target; the stored value remains knowledge until final cutover.
